Running Claude Code: Terminal and VS Code
Claude Code runs in two ways: directly from the terminal, or from inside VS Code. Both connect to the same underlying model — the difference is workflow.
Open a terminal in your project root and type:

This starts an interactive session. You paste your chunk prompt, Claude Code reads your project files, makes edits, and runs commands. When it finishes, you review the diff, run the verification steps, and commit.

Install the Claude Code extension from the VS Code Marketplace. Once installed, a Claude panel appears in the sidebar. You can open a chat session there, or use inline editing (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K) to target a specific file or selection. The extension has access to the same project files as the terminal version.
